content.text:
we have a "mark_complete" checkbox for prescriptions right. as long as this is not dirty, we should auto-toggle this based on the following logic:

1. checked only if ALL/EVERY of the selectable/editable line items / medications are is_selected.

2. unchecked if any of the selectable/editable line items/medications are not is_selected.

note that, this auto-toggle feature should only happen as long as that checkbox is not dirty. while setting it, do not make it dirty

content.text: Added an effect in `PrescriptionSummary` that syncs `markComplete` with the dispenseable line items' `isSelected` state — checked only when every dispenseable item is selected — and it bails out once the field becomes dirty. The `setValue` call uses `shouldDirty: false` / `shouldTouch: false` so the auto-toggle itself never marks it dirty.
